question: The exaggerated response of the ______ system to certain antigens present in the environment is called allergy.
solution:
The correct answer is __**immune**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Allergy** is the exaggerated response of the immune system to** certain antigens** such as **pollen**, **dust**, etc.
 
• Auto-immunity is the damage of **self-cells** by the body due to** an abnormality**. e.g :** rheumatoid arthritis**.
 
• **Inflammation** is the **swelling **and **redness** of an injured region of the body and is a response to **tissue damage**.
 
• It is followed by **repair**.
